name: Decision-Making Under Dynamic Conditions (B)
description:
This study investigates how people make repeated choices when outcomes may change over time.

You will play a game (approximately 25-30 minutes total) in which you click panels to earn points. There is a brief practice round followed by the main task, which consists of several phases.

The task needs a keyboard and a desktop or laptop computer. There are no known risks beyond those of everyday computer use; you may experience mild boredom or fatigue. Full consent information is shown before the task begins.
